name: Health Administration Minor
intro: This 16-unit minor in health administration provides students with a background in administration and management issues in the field of health care and the skills necessary to pursue health-related management opportunities in the for-profit, nonprofit and governmental sectors.

courses.title: Health and Health Care in America Today
Introduction to Health Policy and Law
Fundamentals of Health Policy and Management
Healthcare Foundations: Core Concepts and Terminology
Health Care Systems: A Doctor’s Perspective
Financial Management of Public and Nonprofit Organizations
